title: The last permitted attempt turns a repeated 402 into a terminal error
description: The same 402 means two different things depending only on how many attempts remain. On attempt 1 of 2 it is a re-challenge; on attempt 2 of 2 it is exhaustion, and exhaustion must be a typed terminal error rather than a loop that quietly stops. Both dispositions release, because in neither case did the merchant accept the payment.
